# calculate T cell subsets
```{r subset-T-cells}
gc()
md <- pDataDT(sln); keepCells <- md$cell_ID[which(md$L1.annot == "Tcells")]
Tcells <- subsetGiotto(sln, cell_ids = keepCells )
print("recalculate clusters post-exclusion")
clusterChannels <- c("CD3E", "CD4", "CD8", "TCF1", "GZMB", "CD39", "KI67", "PD1", "TOX", "FOXP3", "ICOS", "CD45RA","HLA.DR")
Tcells <- runPCA(gobject = Tcells, expression_values = "normalized", scale_unit = TRUE, 
              method = "factominer", feats_to_use = clusterChannels)
signPCA(Tcells, scale_unit = TRUE, scree_ylim = c(0,40))
sln.sm <- subsetGiotto(gobject = Tcells, cell_ids = sample(sln$cell_ID, 1e5, replace=F)) # make a smaller dataset to work with 
sln.sm <- createNearestNetwork(gobject = sln.sm, dim_reduction_to_use = 'harmony', dim_reduction_name = 'harmony', 
                            name = 'NN.harmony', dimensions_to_use = 1:10, k = 10)  # calculate nearest neighbors, focus on global differences 
sln.sm <- doLeidenClusterIgraph(gobject = sln.sm, resolution = 0.3, n_iterations = 100, set_seed = T, seed_number = 43,
                                network_name = 'NN.harmony', name = 'leiden_Tcells')  # make the clusters
Tcells <- labelTransfer(x = Tcells, y = sln.sm, labels = "leiden_Tcells")  # assign cluster labels in the full dataset based on the reduced data
Tcells <- runUMAPprojection(Tcells, random_subset = 1e5)  # project UMAP coordinates to the full dataset based on a subsampling
saveRDS(Tcells, "Tcells.RDS")
```

```{r plot-UMAP-heatmap-Tcells, fig.show="hold", out.width="50%"}
md <- pDataDT(Tcells); keepCells <- subset(md, cell_ID %in% sample(md$cell_ID, 5e5))$cell_ID
sln.sm <- subsetGiotto(gobject = Tcells, cell_ids = keepCells)
leiden_colors <- getDistinctColors(length(unique(md$trnsfr_leiden_Tcells)))
names(leiden_colors) <- unique(md$trnsfr_leiden_Tcells)
plots[[1]] <- plotUMAP(gobject = sln.sm, dim_reduction_name = 'umap.projection', cell_color = 'trnsfr_leiden_Tcells',
         cell_color_code = leiden_colors, show_NN_network = F, point_size = 0.75, point_shape="no_border",
         point_alpha=0.5, return_plot=T)
```

```{r label-L2annotation}
md <- pDataDT(Tcells)
df <- data.frame(trnsfr_leiden_Tcells = md$trnsfr_leiden_Tcells, L2.annot = "Unknown")
df$cell_ID <- md$cell_ID
df$L2.annot <- paste0("Tcells.", df$trnsfr_leiden_Tcells)  # unknown clusters:  1,2,3,5,7,8,9,11,21
df[which(df$trnsfr_leiden_Tcells %in% c(4)), 'L2.annot'] <- "CD8.1"
df[which(df$trnsfr_leiden_Tcells %in% c(6)), 'L2.annot'] <- "CD8.2"
df[which(df$trnsfr_leiden_Tcells %in% c(10)), 'L2.annot']  <- "CD8.3"
df[which(df$trnsfr_leiden_Tcells %in% c(12)), 'L2.annot'] <- "CD4.1"
df[which(df$trnsfr_leiden_Tcells %in% c(13)), 'L2.annot'] <- "Treg.1"
df[which(df$trnsfr_leiden_Tcells %in% c(14)), 'L2.annot'] <- "CD4.2"
df[which(df$trnsfr_leiden_Tcells %in% c(15)), 'L2.annot'] <- "CD4.3"
df[which(df$trnsfr_leiden_Tcells %in% c(16)), 'L2.annot'] <- "CD4.4"
df[which(df$trnsfr_leiden_Tcells %in% c(17)), 'L2.annot'] <- "CD4.5"
df[which(df$trnsfr_leiden_Tcells %in% c(18)), 'L2.annot'] <- "CD4.6"
df[which(df$trnsfr_leiden_Tcells %in% c(19)), 'L2.annot'] <- "CD4.6"
df[which(df$trnsfr_leiden_Tcells %in% c(20)), 'L2.annot'] <- "CD8.4"
df$trnsfr_leiden_Tcells <- NULL

Tcells <- addCellMetadata(Tcells, new_metadata = df, by_column = T, column_cell_ID="cell_ID")  # add in the annotations to the main object

md <- pDataDT(Tcells)
keepCells <- subset(md, cell_ID %in% sample(md$cell_ID, 1e5))$cell_ID
sln.sm <- subsetGiotto(gobject = Tcells, cell_ids = keepCells)
leiden_colors <- getDistinctColors(length(unique(md$L2.annot)))
names(leiden_colors) <- unique(md$L2.annot)
plotUMAP(gobject = sln.sm, dim_reduction_name = 'umap.projection', cell_color = 'L2.annot',
         cell_color_code = leiden_colors, show_NN_network = F, point_size = 0.5, point_shape="no_border",
         point_alpha=0.35)

```

```{r merge-in-Tcell-annotations, fig.show="hold", out.width="50%"}
md.sln <- pDataDT(sln)
md.T <- pDataDT(Tcells)
md.sln$L2.annot <- "N/A"
md.sln$L2.annot[which(md.sln$cell_ID %in% md.T$cell_ID)] <- md.T$L2.annot
table(md.sln$L2.annot, useNA="ifany")
df <- md.sln[,c("cell_ID","L2.annot")]
sln <- addCellMetadata(sln, new_metadata = df, by_column = T, column_cell_ID="cell_ID")  # add in the annotations to the main object
rm(md.sln)
rm(md.T)

md <- pDataDT(sln)
keepCells <- subset(md, cell_ID %in% sample(md$cell_ID, 1e5))$cell_ID
sln.sm <- subsetGiotto(gobject = sln, cell_ids = keepCells)
leiden_colors <- getDistinctColors(length(unique(md$L1.annot)))
names(leiden_colors) <- unique(md$L1.annot)
plotUMAP(gobject = sln.sm, dim_reduction_name = 'umap.projection', cell_color = 'L1.annot',
         cell_color_code = leiden_colors, show_NN_network = F, point_size = 0.5, point_shape="no_border",
         point_alpha=0.35)

leiden_colors <- getDistinctColors(length(unique(md$L2.annot)))
names(leiden_colors) <- unique(md$L2.annot)
plotUMAP(gobject = sln.sm, dim_reduction_name = 'umap.projection', cell_color = 'L2.annot',
         cell_color_code = leiden_colors, show_NN_network = F, point_size = 0.5, point_shape="no_border",
         point_alpha=0.35)

```

```{r writeRDS-sln-Tcell-annot}
table(md$L2.annot)

saveRDS(sln, filename)
```
